team.name: Taimoor Sattar
team.bio: I build production-ready web and mobile applications using over six years of full-stack experience. I translate core design systems into reusable code components to construct scalable software. While grounded in traditional coding, I accelerate development cycles using AI models and tools like Antigravity. I direct the complete technical architecture for each project, selecting the exact databases, front-end frameworks, and backend APIs required. To guarantee stable launches, I enforce strict security measures, write comprehensive automated tests, and maintain clear code documentation.
